protocol.time_scope: method setup plus training; solve includes model/RHS construction, excludes validation and timing probes
protocol.calibration_scope: parameterized: per-run high-precision calibration included; single: existing calibration artifact reused, original generation excluded
protocol.memory_scope: summed autograd saved-tensor payload, not allocator peak memory
protocol.paired_controls: initial weights, equation, nodes, RHS, Adam/L-BFGS, canonical validation
protocol.run_order: cyclic rotation across seeds; no simultaneous benchmark processes
